crossRefs.note: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
For we are strangers before you, and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and…
He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…
But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.
Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears…
because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.
Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all…
Yahweh sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. There remained…

translations.web: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
translations.bsb: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
translations.kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
translations.asv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
